detection_approach: Binary real/fake CNN classifier with careful pre-/post-processing and Blur+JPEG data augmentation
model_architecture: ResNet-50 (ImageNet-pretrained)
dataset_used: ForenSynths (720K train images ProGAN real/fake; 11-generator test sets; LSUN reals)
generators_covered: ProGAN (train); tested on StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, DeepFakes, CRN, IMLE, SAN, SITD
reported_accuracy_auc: mAP 90.8 avg over 11 unseen-generator test sets with Blur+JPEG(0.5) aug (90.1 without aug)
key_limitation: Performs at chance on traditional (Photoshop-style) manipulations; 'for now' caveat that future generators may evade it

detection_approach: Patch-based classification with limited receptive fields; heatmaps of which patches are detectable
model_architecture: Truncated Xception and ResNet patch classifiers (Xception blocks best)
dataset_used: CelebA-HQ (24,183 train), FFHQ (60,000 train), FaceForensics++
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, Glow, GMM face generator; FF++ manipulations
reported_accuracy_auc: AP 99.99 training on ProGAN, testing on StyleGAN (patch classifier); AP ~100 across unseen resolutions
key_limitation: 'No method is completely bulletproof' - better generators, out-of-distribution images, or adversarial attacks can defeat it

detection_approach: Critical benchmark of SOTA GAN-image detectors under realistic conditions (compression, resizing, unseen generators)
model_architecture: Seven detectors: Xception, SRNet, Spec, M-Gb, Co-Net, Wang2020 ResNet50, PatchForensics + proposed no-down variant
dataset_used: 362K LSUN reals + 362K ProGAN fakes (train); test reals from ImageNet, COCO, RAISE (~39K synthetic test)
generators_covered: ProGAN (train); tested StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, RelGAN, GauGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: AUC above 0.9 for several methods on uncompressed unseen GANs; severe drops after compression/resizing; best no-down variant above 90% accuracy
key_limitation: Authors state 'we are still very far from having reliable tools for GAN image detection'; robustness experiments preliminary

detection_approach: Learned GAN fingerprints for real/fake classification and closed-set source attribution
model_architecture: Deep CNN attribution classifier (fingerprint = final 1x1x512 feature/weight tensors); AutoEncoder visualization variant
dataset_used: CelebA and LSUN bedroom (20,000 reals each; 100K train / 10K test images per source)
generators_covered: ProGAN, SNGAN, CramerGAN, MMDGAN (all outputs 128x128x3)
reported_accuracy_auc: Accuracy 99.43% (CelebA) / 98.58% (LSUN) on 5-class {real + 4 GANs} attribution, vs PRNU baseline 86.61/67.84
key_limitation: Closed-set: needs source-labelled samples from every candidate GAN; evaluated only at 128x128 output size

detection_approach: PRNU-style hand-crafted GAN fingerprint: average of denoising residuals, correlation-based source identification
model_architecture: Denoising-filter residual averaging (no learned classifier)
dataset_used: 1,000 RGB 256x256 images per source; RAISE camera images; CycleGAN/ProGAN/StarGAN category sets
generators_covered: CycleGAN (9 configs), ProGAN (6 configs), StarGAN (5 configs)
reported_accuracy_auc: Source-attribution accuracy 90.3% uncompressed, 90.1% after JPEG QF=95 (Sec. 4 source identification)
cross_generator_tested: no - source ID among known GANs
key_limitation: Weaker on StarGAN male/smiling networks and on real cameras (low-energy PRNU patterns)

detection_approach: Frequency-spectrum classifier targeting GAN upsampling artifacts; AutoGAN simulator generates artifacts without needing real fakes
model_architecture: ResNet-34 (ImageNet-pretrained) on log frequency spectrum (phase discarded)
dataset_used: CycleGAN 14-category image sets + 4,000 MSCOCO images for AutoGAN training
generators_covered: CycleGAN (primary), StarGAN, GauGAN tested
reported_accuracy_auc: Accuracy 97.2 avg (leave-one-out) for AutoGAN-trained spectrum classifier that never saw real fakes; 99.8 CycleGAN-trained
cross_generator_tested: yes - detects unseen GANs via simulated artifacts
key_limitation: All classifiers fail on GauGAN (different upsampler); sensitive to up-sampler mismatch and training-category choice

detection_approach: DCT frequency-domain analysis of grid-like upsampling artifacts with simple classifiers
model_architecture: Ridge regression and shallow 4-conv-layer CNN (~170K params) on DCT spectra
dataset_used: FFHQ, CelebA, LSUN bedrooms
generators_covered: StyleGAN, BigGAN, ProGAN, SN-DCGAN, CramerGAN, MMDGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: Ridge-Regression-DCT 100.00% accuracy real-vs-fake on FFHQ (vs 75.78% on pixels); CNN-DCT source ID 99.64% LSUN / 99.07% CelebA
cross_generator_tested: no - artefacts shown across the GANs analysed (six overall: BigGAN, ProGAN, StyleGAN, SN-DCGAN in the DCT analysis; ProGAN, SN-DCGAN, CramerGAN, MMDGAN in classification), but no train-on-one/test-on-unseen-GAN experiment
key_limitation: Classifier can still be evaded by specifically crafted adversarial perturbations

detection_approach: Azimuthal integration of DFT power spectrum into 1D spectral feature + classical classifiers; proposes spectral regularization
model_architecture: SVM, logistic regression, K-means (unsupervised) on spectral feature
dataset_used: Faces-HQ (40K, self-built), CelebA (202,599), FaceForensics++
generators_covered: DCGAN, DRAGAN, LSGAN, WGAN-GP (CelebA); FaceForensics++ deepfakes
reported_accuracy_auc: Accuracy 100% on Faces-HQ (SVM, 1000 samples) and 100% on CelebA (2000 samples); 85% on FF++ single frames
key_limitation: Detection assumes up-convolution generators; other generation techniques may not show these spectral signatures

detection_approach: Global texture (Gram) statistics for fake face detection
model_architecture: Gram-Net (CNN leveraging global texture representations)
dataset_used: CelebA-HQ, FFHQ, CelebA (real); GAN face sets; ImageNet/BigGAN (natural)
generators_covered: StyleGAN, PGGAN, DCGAN, DRAGAN, StarGAN, BigGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: ~77.7% acc cross-GAN (train StyleGAN, test DCGAN/DRAGAN/StarGAN); >98% in-domain
key_limitation: Authors state analysis covers only texture contrast; real/fake differences go beyond it

detection_approach: Pixel-domain co-occurrence matrices fed to deep CNN
model_architecture: Deep CNN on 3-channel co-occurrence matrices
dataset_used: Two GAN datasets, 56,000+ images (unpaired translation; facial attributes)
generators_covered: CycleGAN, StarGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: >99% classification accuracy on both datasets
cross_generator_tested: yes - trained on one GAN, tested on the other
key_limitation: Only two GAN families evaluated; no explicit limitation stated in abstract

detection_approach: Contrastive learning with limited sub-sampling architecture
model_architecture: ResNet50 (ImageNet-pretrained, no first-layer subsampling) + 2 projection layers
dataset_used: LSUN (362K real) + 362K ProGAN images (train); ImageNet, COCO, RAISE (test)
generators_covered: ProGAN (train); StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, RelGAN, GauGAN (unseen test)
reported_accuracy_auc: 95.6% acc / 0.997 AUC avg on unseen GAN architectures
key_limitation: Robustness to adversarial attacks left to future work

detection_approach: Frequency-level perturbation maps (FrePGAN) to suppress frequency artifacts
model_architecture: Perturbation generator + ResNet-50 deepfake classifier
dataset_used: ProGAN-generated train set; test images from FFHQ, LSUN, ImageNet, CelebA, COCO, Deepfake sets
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: 79.4% avg acc / 87.2% avg precision cross-model (4 training classes)
cross_generator_tested: yes - known and unseen GAN models
key_limitation: Tradeoff: frequency artifacts aid known-GAN detection but reduce cross-GAN generalization

detection_approach: Ensemble of orthogonally trained CNNs favoring real-image scores
model_architecture: Ensemble of five EfficientNet-B4 CNNs
dataset_used: FFHQ, Metfaces, AFHQ2 (~116K real) + ~200K synthetic (train); StyleGAN3 test pairs
generators_covered: StyleGAN2, StarGAN-v2, Taming Transformers, FaceVid2Vid, score-based models; StyleGAN3 (unseen)
reported_accuracy_auc: 0.9995 AUC on global test set incl. unseen StyleGAN3
key_limitation: Orthogonality among CNNs only empirically verified; no theoretical grounding

detection_approach: Fusion of global spatial and local patch features via attention
model_architecture: Two-branch ResNet-50 (ImageNet-pretrained) + patch selection module + multi-head attention
dataset_used: Self-built diverse test set: 128,424 images from 19 generation models
generators_covered: 19 models: ProGAN, StyleGAN/2/3, BigGAN, WGAN, VAEGAN, GauGAN, StarGAN, CycleGAN, Pix2Pix, CRN, IMLE, SITD, SAN, FF++, Celeb-DF, Transformers, BGM
reported_accuracy_auc: 91.73% mean AP on unseen models (96.91% global AP mixed)
key_limitation: Resizing high-resolution images makes artifacts harder to detect

detection_approach: Learning on Gradients (LGrad): gradients from pretrained CNN as generalized artifact representation
model_architecture: Pretrained CNN transformation model converting images to gradients + classifier
dataset_used: Training set of Wang et al. (ForenSynths/CNNDetection): 20 ProGAN categories, 18,000 fake + 18,000 real images each; 1-class (horse), 2-class and 4-class training settings
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, Deepfake (8 test models)
reported_accuracy_auc: 86.3% mean ACC / 92.7% mean AP over the 8 test models (1-class setting, StyleGAN-bedroom transformation model); +11.4% ACC and +13.4% AP over FrePGAN
cross_generator_tested: yes - cross-model and cross-data, unseen domains
key_limitation: Turns data-dependent problem into a transformation-model-dependent one (authors' own framing)

detection_approach: Neighboring Pixel Relationships (NPR) capturing up-sampling artifacts
model_architecture: Lightweight CNN (conv layers + ResNet blocks, 1.44M params) on NPR
dataset_used: ForenSynths ProGAN 4-class train (car, cat, chair, horse; 18K fake + 18K real per class)
generators_covered: 28 generative models: 16 GANs, 1 deepfake method, 11 diffusion models
reported_accuracy_auc: 92.2% mean acc across 28 generators (+11.6% over prior SOTA)
cross_generator_tested: yes - 28 unseen GAN and diffusion models
key_limitation: No explicit limitation stated; trained solely on ProGAN 4-class data

detection_approach: Frequency-domain forensics: azimuthally-averaged 1D power spectrum features + classical classifier
model_architecture: SVM (RBF), logistic regression, K-means (unsupervised)
dataset_used: Faces-HQ (40K, self-assembled), CelebA, FaceForensics++
generators_covered: Self-trained DCGAN; fakes from thispersondoesnotexist.com; FF++ manipulations
reported_accuracy_auc: 100% accuracy on Faces-HQ with as few as 20 labeled samples; 91% accuracy on FF++ videos
key_limitation: Low-resolution content harder to identify since available frequency spectrum is much smaller

detection_approach: High-frequency Fourier spectral-decay analysis (fitted decay parameters)
model_architecture: KNN (k=5) on decay parameters
dataset_used: FFHQ + Cat Head Detection dataset (~5,000 images, 10/90 train/test)
generators_covered: StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, PGGAN, VQ-VAE2, ALAE
reported_accuracy_auc: 99.2% accuracy, uncompressed 1024x1024 images, mixed-generator training
cross_generator_tested: no - five generators, none held out unseen
key_limitation: At 85% JPEG compression generated spectra become essentially indistinguishable from real; accuracy drops to 88.8% at 256x256

detection_approach: Counter-study of high-frequency spectral-decay features (shows artifact removable via upsampling choice)
model_architecture: KNN (k=5) on 3 spectral features (also SVM, MLP); GANs retrained with modified last-layer upsampling
dataset_used: CelebA (128), LSUN Bedrooms (128), CelebA-HQ (512)
generators_covered: DCGAN, LSGAN, WGAN-GP, StarGAN (+CRN, IMLE supplementary)
reported_accuracy_auc: Detection rate collapses to 0-0.3% with bilinear upsampling vs 84.8-99.8% baseline
key_limitation: Its own finding: high-frequency spectral decay is not intrinsic to CNN-generated images, so detectors built on it are unreliable

detection_approach: Bilateral high-pass filters (frequency-level + pixel-level) amplifying frequency artifacts
model_architecture: ResNet-50 classifier with BiHPF front-end
dataset_used: LSUN, FFHQ (real); ProGAN images for training
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: 84.2% mean accuracy / 81.8% mean AP on unseen GAN models (4-class ProGAN training)
cross_generator_tested: yes - trained on ProGAN, tested on 5 unseen GANs
key_limitation: No limitations stated; evaluation covers GAN generators only

detection_approach: Frequency-space learning: high-frequency image/feature representations + convolution in FFT domain
model_architecture: FreqNet - lightweight CNN with residual blocks, no pretraining, 1.9M parameters
dataset_used: ForenSynths (ProGAN training, 1/2/4-class) + GAN self-synthesis test sets
generators_covered: 17 GANs incl. ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, AttGAN, plus Deepfake set
reported_accuracy_auc: 92.8% mean accuracy over 17 GAN test sets, +9.8% over Ojha (83.0%)
key_limitation: No limitations stated in conclusion; evaluation restricted to GAN sources

detection_approach: Benchmark of GAN detectors on diffusion images + frequency-domain artifact analysis + retraining
model_architecture: Wang2020 (ResNet-50), Gragnaniello2021, Mandelli2022 (EfficientNet-B4 ensemble)
dataset_used: LSUN Bedroom 256 (primary); LSUN Cat/Horse, ImageNet, FFHQ extensions
generators_covered: 5 GANs (ProGAN, StyleGAN, ProjectedGAN, Diff-StyleGAN2, Diff-ProjectedGAN) + 5 DMs (DDPM, IDDPM, ADM, PNDM, LDM)
reported_accuracy_auc: GAN detectors drop on average 15.2% AUROC on DM images; DM-trained detector reaches 94.26% avg Pd@1%FAR on GANs, GAN-trained only 26.34% on DMs
key_limitation: DMs leave fewer detectable artifacts and perturbations degrade DM detectability more strongly

detection_approach: Forensic-trace (spectral fingerprint) analysis of diffusion models + evaluation of existing detectors
model_architecture: Spec, PatchForensics, Wang2020 (ResNet-50 w/ augmentation), Grag2021 (no first-layer downsampling)
dataset_used: Real: COCO, ImageNet, UCID; COCO prompts for generation
generators_covered: GLIDE, Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, ADM, DALL-E 2 (+ProGAN, StyleGAN2/3, BigGAN, EG3D references)
reported_accuracy_auc: Accuracy ~60-76% (AUC ~75-93%) on uncompressed DM images; falls to ~50-61% accuracy in compressed/resized social-network scenario
cross_generator_tested: yes - GAN-trained detectors tested on DM images
key_limitation: Generalization remains the main hurdle; GAN-trained detectors work poorly on DM images, worse under compression/resizing

detection_approach: Diffusion reconstruction error (DIRE): residual between image and its DDIM reconstruction as detection cue
model_architecture: ResNet-50 classifier on DIRE maps; ADM (LSUN-Bedroom) reconstructor, DDIM 20 steps
dataset_used: DiffusionForensics benchmark (LSUN-Bedroom, ImageNet sources)
generators_covered: 8 DMs: ADM, DDPM, iDDPM, PNDM, LDM, SD-v1, SD-v2, VQ-Diffusion
reported_accuracy_auc: 99.9% average accuracy / 100 AP across 8 diffusion models incl. unseen (ADM-trained)
cross_generator_tested: yes - generalizes to unseen diffusion models
key_limitation: No limitations stated; scope limited to diffusion-generated images

detection_approach: Text-to-image fake detection + attribution via image-only and hybrid (image+prompt) classifiers
model_architecture: ResNet18 (image-only); CLIP image+text encoders + 2-layer MLP (hybrid)
dataset_used: MSCOCO, Flickr30k (real) + fakes from four T2I models
generators_covered: Stable Diffusion, Latent Diffusion, GLIDE, DALL-E 2
reported_accuracy_auc: Hybrid detector trained on SD: accuracy 0.932/0.899/0.885 on Latent Diffusion/GLIDE/DALL-E 2 (MSCOCO)
cross_generator_tested: yes - trained on SD, tested on three unseen T2I models
key_limitation: Image-only detection 'far from the design goal' on other models such as GLIDE and DALL-E 2

detection_approach: Stepwise error between deterministic reverse and denoising diffusion steps (SeDID)
model_architecture: SeDID_Stat (statistical) and SeDID_NNs (neural network) variants
dataset_used: CIFAR-10, TinyImageNet, CelebA (all 32x32)
generators_covered: DDPM only
reported_accuracy_auc: SeDID_NNs: average AUC 0.9634 / ACC 0.9399 across the three datasets
cross_generator_tested: no - DDPM only, no other generator families
key_limitation: Dataset-dependent optimal timestep selection; unusual trends on CelebA need further investigation

detection_approach: Training-free detection via autoencoder reconstruction error of LDMs
model_architecture: Pre-trained LDM autoencoders + reconstruction distance (LPIPS); no trained classifier
dataset_used: Real images from LAION-5B + generated counterparts (prompt-matched; Midjourney set from Discord)
generators_covered: Stable Diffusion 1.1/1.5/2.1, Kandinsky 2.1, Midjourney 4/5/5.1
reported_accuracy_auc: Mean AP 0.992 across state-of-the-art LDMs incl. SD, Kandinsky, Midjourney
cross_generator_tested: yes - multiple LDMs incl. proprietary Midjourney
key_limitation: Best results require access to the generating LDM's autoencoder; method scoped to latent diffusion models

detection_approach: Latent reconstruction error (LaRE) feature for diffusion-image detection
model_architecture: LaRE feature + Error-Guided feature REfinement module (EGRE, spatial+channel align-then-refine)
dataset_used: GenImage benchmark
generators_covered: 8 image generators (GenImage subsets)
reported_accuracy_auc: Surpasses SOTA by up to 11.9%/12.1% average ACC/AP across 8 generators on GenImage
key_limitation: Authors report residual real/fake feature overlap on unseen generators (Midjourney, ADM, BigGAN); LaRE alone is insufficient as sole input due to latent-space information loss

detection_approach: Forensic frequency/spectral artifact analysis of synthetic images (analysis paper, no detector proposed)
model_architecture: None - spectral analyses (power spectra, autocorrelation, radial/angular spectra)
dataset_used: Real: ImageNet, FFHQ, LAION; synthetic images from 13 models
generators_covered: GANs (BigGAN, StyleGAN2/3, StyleGAN-T, GALIP), VQ models, DMs (Score-SDE, ADM, GLIDE, DALL-E 2, eDiff-I), latent DMs (LDM, SD, DiT)
reported_accuracy_auc: None reported - qualitative artifact characterization, no detection metrics
cross_generator_tested: no - no detector trained; artifacts compared across families
key_limitation: Post-processing 'may significantly modify and hide' the identified artifacts

detection_approach: Exposing/removing JPEG-compression and image-size biases in detection datasets
model_architecture: ResNet50 and Swin-T detectors
dataset_used: GenImage
generators_covered: Midjourney, SD v1.4, SD v1.5, Wukong, VQDM, ADM, GLIDE, BigGAN
reported_accuracy_auc: Bias-corrected training raises cross-generator accuracy >11 pp on GenImage: ResNet50 71.68%->82.74%, Swin-T 74.09%->85.83%
cross_generator_tested: yes - cross-generator evaluation across GenImage subsets
key_limitation: Even with constraints, 'datasets may contain other undesirable biases' (style differences, generator fingerprints)

detection_approach: Contrastive training on diffusion-reconstructed hard samples (DRCT framework)
model_architecture: ConvNeXt-B and CLIP-ViT-L/14 (UnivFD) backbones (per official code repo)
dataset_used: DRCT-2M (proposed, million-scale), GenImage; real images from MSCOCO
generators_covered: 16 types of diffusion models (incl. SD v1.4/v2)
reported_accuracy_auc: Over 10% accuracy improvement in cross-set tests (trained on SD v1.4, tested on GenImage subsets)
cross_generator_tested: yes - unseen diffusion models, cross-set tests
key_limitation: Authors' stated limitations: improvement on non-diffusion (GAN) images is less marked; evaluation covers only globally generated images, not small locally generated regions

detection_approach: Detection via Stable Diffusion inversion features
model_architecture: ResNet50 trained from scratch on concatenated image + decoded noise map + reconstruction
dataset_used: Real: LAION, WebLI, reverse-image-search sets; new SynRIS benchmark (15 eval sets)
generators_covered: Trained on SD; evaluated on 15+ incl. DALL-E 2/3, Midjourney, Imagen, Kandinsky 2/3, PixArt-alpha, SDXL, Playground 2.5, Stable Cascade
reported_accuracy_auc: Average AUC-ROC 0.759 across tested generators under RIS protocol (trained on SD+LAION)
cross_generator_tested: yes - trained on SD only, tested on unseen T2I models
key_limitation: May not transfer to non-diffusion T2I models (GANs, transformers); inversion pipeline needs significantly more compute

detection_approach: Zero-shot entropy-based forensics (coding cost of real-image model, trained on real images only)
model_architecture: Lossless multi-resolution neural image encoder (ZED)
dataset_used: Open Images (~338k real images) for encoder training; 19-generator synthetic test set
generators_covered: 19 generators incl. GauGAN, BigGAN, StyleGAN2, GigaGAN, ADM, GLIDE, SD/SDXL, DiT, DALL-E 1/2/3, Midjourney v5, Firefly
reported_accuracy_auc: ~90.0% avg AUC across 19 generators; >3% avg accuracy gain over SoTA
key_limitation: Unreliable on heavily compressed/resized images; detects fully generated images only, not local manipulations

detection_approach: Supervised detector trained on massively diverse multi-generator dataset
model_architecture: ViT-S (CLIP-pretrained) classifier; ConvNeXt-S also tested
dataset_used: Community Forensics (2.7M images, 4,803 generators); eval on Wang, Ojha, Synthbuster, GenImage + own 21-model eval set
generators_covered: 4,803 generators: latent/pixel diffusion, GANs, commercial models
reported_accuracy_auc: 0.987 mAP and 89.2% accuracy on out-of-distribution eval set (21 unseen models)
key_limitation: Dataset skewed toward diffusion models; error rates still too high for critical applications

detection_approach: Hybrid low-level (frequency/noise) + high-level (semantic) mixture-of-experts detection; proposes in-the-wild Chameleon benchmark
model_architecture: AIDE: DCT scoring module + SRM noise filters + OpenCLIP semantic encoder
dataset_used: AIGCDetectBenchmark, GenImage, Chameleon (proposed)
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN/2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, ADM, Glide, SD v1.4/1.5, VQDM, Wukong, Midjourney, DALLE-2/3
reported_accuracy_auc: 92.77% mean acc on AIGCDetectBenchmark, 86.88% on GenImage; drops to 65.77% on Chameleon
key_limitation: All tested detectors near-fail on realistic Chameleon images; problem 'far from being solved'

detection_approach: Real-vs-fake classification without training the backbone: nearest-neighbor / linear probing in frozen vision-language feature space
model_architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder (last-layer features) + NN or linear probe
dataset_used: ProGAN real/fake training set (720k images); ForenSynths + diffusion/AR test sets
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, CRN, IMLE, SAN, SITD, DeepFakes, Guided, LDM, Glide, DALL-E
reported_accuracy_auc: +15.07 mAP / +25.90% acc over SoTA on unseen diffusion and autoregressive models
key_limitation: Why frozen CLIP feature space separates real from fake 'remains an open question'

detection_approach: Few-shot CLIP-feature forensics: linear SVM on frozen CLIP features from a handful of reference images
model_architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 (next-to-last-layer features) + linear SVM
dataset_used: Few paired real/fake reference images (10 to 10k) from a single generator; 18-generator test suite
generators_covered: 18 generators: ProGAN, StyleGAN2/3/T, GigaGAN, Score-SDE, ADM, GLIDE, eDiff-I, LDM, SD variants, DiT, DeepFloyd-IF, DALL-E 2/3, Midjourney v5, Firefly
reported_accuracy_auc: ~90.0% avg AUC across 18 generators; +6% AUC OOD and +13% on impaired data vs SoTA
key_limitation: Interpretability lacking: which forensic features CLIP exploits is not yet understood

detection_approach: Synthetic-image detection from intermediate CLIP encoder-block representations with learnable importance weighting
model_architecture: RINE: frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 intermediate blocks + lightweight trainable projection/weighting network
dataset_used: ProGAN training data (1/2/4-class settings); 20 test datasets
generators_covered: ProGAN, StyleGAN/2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, GauGAN, DeepFake, SITD, SAN, CRN, IMLE, Guided, LDM (3), Glide (3), DALL-E
reported_accuracy_auc: 91.5% avg accuracy and 98.8 AP (4-class training) across 20 test sets; +10.6% ACC over SoTA
key_limitation: Combined perturbations (blur + crop + compression + noise) considerably reduce performance

detection_approach: Forgery-aware adaptive transfer of CLIP: adapter over image + frequency domains with language-guided alignment
model_architecture: FatFormer (CLIP-ViT + forgery-aware adapter + text-prompt alignment)
dataset_used: ProGAN 4-class training set; unseen GAN and diffusion test sets
generators_covered: GANs and diffusion models (unseen at test time)
reported_accuracy_auc: 98% accuracy on unseen GANs, 95% on unseen diffusion models
cross_generator_tested: yes - unseen GANs and diffusion models
key_limitation: Trained on ProGAN data only; authors state room to improve on diffusion models, e.g. Guided, and that GAN vs diffusion artefact relationships remain unresolved

detection_approach: Category-common prompt injected into CLIP text encoder to embed detection semantics into image features
model_architecture: C2P-CLIP (CLIP ViT-L/14 with category common prompt)
dataset_used: UniversalFakeDetect (ProGAN train, 19 test subsets) and GenImage (SDv1.4 train)
generators_covered: 20 generation models (UniversalFakeDetect subsets + GenImage diffusion models)
reported_accuracy_auc: 93.79% accuracy / 98.66% mAP on UniversalFakeDetect 19 test subsets; 95.8% acc on GenImage
key_limitation: Word-frequency prompt analysis lacks full-caption analysis, giving incomplete information

detection_approach: Adapting vision-language model (CLIP) via prompt tuning for universal detection
model_architecture: CLIP ViT (prompt tuning; vs linear probe, fine-tune, adapter)
dataset_used: ProGAN 200k train; 21 test datasets
generators_covered: GANs, diffusion models, commercial tools
reported_accuracy_auc: 98.06% mAP / 89.45% avg accuracy across 18 unseen generators (prompt tuning)
key_limitation: Performance drops on commercial-tool images under JPEG compression

detection_approach: Cross-forgery comparison of ViT vs CNN classifiers
model_architecture: ViT-Base vs EfficientNetV2-M
dataset_used: ForgeryNet (15 manipulation methods)
generators_covered: GAN/reenactment/swap methods incl. FaceShifter, StyleGAN2, Talking Head Video, FS-GAN, Deepfakes, ATVG-net
reported_accuracy_auc: Accuracy on unseen methods: EfficientNetV2-M 47.0-57.0% (81.1% seen) vs ViT-Base ~62.0% on all three
cross_generator_tested: yes - trained on subsets, tested on all 15 methods
key_limitation: Accuracies remain rather low on novel unseen methods

detection_approach: Orthogonal subspace decomposition (SVD) of frozen foundation-model features (Effort)
model_architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 (BEiT-v2, SigLIP ablations)
dataset_used: ProGAN train; 19 UniversalFakeDetect test subsets (also FF++ for deepfakes)
generators_covered: ProGAN, CycleGAN, BigGAN, StyleGAN, GauGAN, StarGAN, Guided/Latent Diffusion, GLIDE, DALL-E
reported_accuracy_auc: 99.41% mAP / 95.19% mAcc across 19 test subsets incl. unseen generators
key_limitation: No technical limitations discussed; only misuse risk acknowledged

detection_approach: CNN binary real-vs-fake classification with Grad-CAM explainability
model_architecture: Custom CNN (best of 36 topologies: 2 conv layers x32 filters + dense 64)
dataset_used: CIFAKE: 120,000 images (60k CIFAR-10 real + 60k synthetic)
generators_covered: Stable Diffusion v1.4 (latent diffusion)
